82cdb3be211488da9978a21e1d1ef34a49e8a332:
query FlxForm($id: ID!) {
  flxForm(id: $id) {
    id
    title
    formType
    steps
    buttonLabel
    successTitle
    successMessage
    currency
    stepList {
      number
      title
      help
    }
    fields {
      id
      type
      label
      required
      placeholder
      help
      step
      width
      defaultValue
      min
      max
      settings
      options {
        value
        label
        price
        image
      }
      rows {
        value
        label
      }
    }
  }
}
f58f1e2dd498c32e6ec1c8ffc5d8542cc4be11fe:
mutation FlxFormsSettingsUpdate($input: FlxFormsSettingsUpdateInput!) {
  flxFormsSettingsUpdate(input: $input) {
    settings {
      ...FlxFormsSettingsAll
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}
